chunks.text:
Pricing (Institutional)

Step 1: Online course: $300

Step 2: Online Credit By Exam: $80

Step 3: Print Credit By Exam: $30

Step 4: District-proctored online Credit By Exam: $30

Step 5: District partners get 15% off online courses

Payment rules

Step 1: We accept purchase orders, credit cards, or checks from schools.

Step 2: Payment and forms must arrive before we process the order.

Step 3: All Credit By Exam fees are non-refundable. Print Credit By Exams can be substituted.

How to place an order

Step 1: Print Credit By Exams: complete the Institutional Testing Services Enrollment Form and, if ordering for multiple campuses, submit a Test Summary Form for each campus.

Step 2: Online Credit By Exams: complete the online order spreadsheet and submit it via our portal. Include Credit By Exam name, semester, Purchase Order (PO) number or payment tracking identification (ID), and test date.

Step 3: District-proctored online Credit By Exams: available only for specific courses (e.g., Algebra 1A/B, Biology 1A/B, English 1A/B, Spanish 1A/B, US History 1A/B). Ask us if you are unsure.

Order processing times (recommended submission)

Step 1: Small (1–50 exams): submit 2 weeks before test date. Processed within 2 business days.

Step 2: Medium (51–100): submit 3 weeks before. Processed within 3 business days.

Step 3: Large (100+): submit 1 month before. Processed within 5–7 business days.

Step 4: District-proctored online Credit By Exam passwords are emailed after orders are processed.

Online exam rules & Identification

Step 1: Proctorio is required for online proctored exams.

Step 2: Students must show one valid photo identification (ID) before testing:

Step 3: state identification/driver’s license, school identification, passport, yearbook photo with name, or a labeled school photo in the student file.

Student ID Cards

We recommend all students in Texas Tech K-12 full-time programs receive an ID card. The card provides student authentication for state and national testing, final exam proctoring services, and school attendance verification.

To receive an ID card, fill out an Identity Verification form (opnes in new tab).

Student Identification Cards

We recommend all students in Texas Tech K-12 full-time programs receive an ID card. The card provides student authentication for state and national testing, final exam proctoring services, and school attendance verification.

To receive an ID card, fill out an Identity Verification form (opens in new tab).

Untimely Filings

All time limits shall be strictly followed unless modified by mutual written consent.

If a complaint form or appeal notice is not timely filed, the complaint may be dismissed, on written notice to the student or parent, at any point during the complaint process. The student or parent may appeal the dismissal by seeking review in writing within 10 days from the date of the written dismissal notice, starting at the level at which the complaint was dismissed. Such appeal shall be limited to the issue of timeliness.

How do I apply for enrollment for a new child?

Full-time Texas Tech K-12 enrollment is required for participation in the College Preparatory Academy.

Upon getting to the bottom of the page, you will be presented with the following screen. Parents that are registering their students for the Texas Tech K-12 Supplemental Program or Texas Tech K-12 Full-Time Diploma program should select the "Texas Tech K-12 Intake Form".

Following the Form Type selection, pressing the "Begin" button will take you to the next page to select the program that you are interested in signing your student up for. As Texas Tech K-12 continues to expand, we are pleased to offer the following programs:

Supplemental Individual Student (Part-Time) (opens in new tab)

If you remain enrolled at your local school and want to take a Texas Tech K-12 course to graduate early or on time, take courses not offered at your local school, make up failed credits, or have an alternative for summer school, you will select the Supplemental/Part-time option. Students must receive prior approval from their school counselor before enrolling in any course or Credit By Exam. Failure to obtain approval may result in unawarded credit for a course or Credit By Exam.

Below is a list of the Texas Tech K-12 Tuition, Fees, and Discounts that are effective as of Sept 1, 2022*. Please note once a student submits an assignment for grading, they are no longer eligible for a refund in the tuition-paid or supplemental programs.

How long do I have to complete a course?

Step 1: Students expiration date will be posted in their student portal. Actual end dates vary depending on the enrollment date.

Explanation

Table of Contents

Quick actions

Step 1: Decide if you want an online or print Credit By Exams (CBEs).

Step 2: Place your order and pay before we process it.

Step 3: Make sure students have the required device, browser, and ID for proctored exams.

Step 4: Upload the proctor form on test day for online Credit By Exams (CBEs) or mail print Credit By Exams (CBEs) back to us.

Key terms

AI (generative AI)

Generative AI — automated tools that create text, images or code (for example, ChatGPT or PhotoMath). The policy on this page forbids using these tools to do assignments or exams.

CBE

Credit-by-Exam — a test a student takes to earn course credit.

What do I need to take my exam?

Step 1: A Quiet Area - Find a quiet and distraction-free area where you feel comfortable taking your exam. Prepare to be seated here for the entire duration of the exam.

Step 2: A Webcam and Microphone - A working webcam and microphone are required.

Step 3: A Computer with Proctorio - Any desktop or laptop computer with a good internet connection with Google Chrome (opens in new tab) and the Proctorio extension (opens in new tab) installed should be sufficient. Please note You cannot take the exams from mobile devices (e.g., iPhone, iPad, Android device, etc)

Step 4: A valid photo ID - You will be asked to hold up your photo ID to document that you are the test taker.

Things to keep in mind while taking your Test
Processing and Shipping Times

Is there a fee to take the TSI Assessment?

There is a $50 fee each time your take the TSI Assessment at Texas Tech University. For more information, visit our FAQ page.

Online TSI testing option.

Step 1: Go to www.depts.ttu.edu/testing (opens in new tab) and select Exam Services. Then select off-campus testing voucher to fill out the request form.

Step 2: Do your pre-assessment (if you haven’t already). You’ll receive an email with this link after you submit your request form.

You will have to meet certain equipment requirements set by the online vendor to test online. You will need a webcam, speakers and microphone on your computer. You can find out more at https://examity.com/accuplacer-students/ (opens in new tab). Please watch the video under scheduling.

Payment Information:

The Texas Tech remote setup fee is $30 (this will be paid by debit or credit through an online system). There is a separate proctoring fee for Examity that you will pay directly to Examity when you set up your time. The Examity fee is approximately $25 (plus tax) but could go up. After you do the request and pre-assessment, you’ll receive an email from testing@ttu.edu to make your online payment. This will take 1 – 2 business days.

Within 3 business days of receiving your payment, your voucher will be created. This will come from Accuplacer.

You will set an appointment through Examity after you get your voucher from Accuplacer. Read through the instructions on the voucher email at that time.

When should I expect to receive my package after it has been shipped?

Shipping time depends on the shipping address. Most packages take from three to four business days. In some cases, it will take longer. You can request overnight delivery, although this only shortens the shipping time. (The $30.00 overnight delivery fee is non-refundable). You must still allow one to two business days to process the order. You can track your package with the tracking numb sent on the automated email message.

How long do I have to complete a course?

Step 1: Students expiration date will be posted in their student portal. Actual end dates vary depending on the enrollment date.

**Texas Tech K-12 Student ID Card Processing Time**

- After you submit the Identity Verification form for a Texas Tech K-12 student ID card, processing typically takes at least two working days for your academic advisor to review your progress and eligibility.
- Once approved, the ID card will be processed and sent to you.

**Next Steps**
- If you have not received your ID card or need to check the status, please contact your Texas Tech K-12 academic advisor or reach out to the support team at 1-800-692-6877 or ttuk12@ttu.edu.

Courses & Credit-by-Exams — Institutional Services (Texas Tech K-12)

Texas Tech K-12 offers courses and Credit-by-Exams (CBEs) for schools. This page explains prices, ordering, technical needs and how to return exams.

Step 1: Texas Tech K-12 offers 150+ online courses and Credit-by-Exams (CBEs).

Step 2: Schools, districts, and educational centers can buy courses or Credit By Exams for students.

Step 3: Students have 180 days from enrollment to finish a Credit By Exam.

Benefits of the Texas Tech K-12 Supplemental Program

Step 1: Allow students to start with Texas Tech K-12 at anytime

Step 2: From the date of enrollment, students have six months (180 days) to complete the course

Step 3: Complete final exams from home with Texas Tech K-12’s proctoring service, Proctorio.

Step 4: Graduate Early or On Time: Stay on track—or get ahead—with courses that complement your current school curriculum.

Step 5: Access Advanced Placement (AP) Courses: Challenge yourself with college-level coursework that prepares you for higher education and boosts your college applications.

Step 6: Expand Your Learning Options: Enroll in courses not available at traditional schools to broaden your academic experience.

Step 7: Learn on Your Schedule: Our self-paced format fits seamlessly with your existing school schedule and commitments.

Step 8: Recover Credits: Retake courses to make up failed credits and stay on track for graduation.

Step 9: Replace Summer School: Complete required coursework during the summer without a traditional classroom setting.

Dynamic Curriculum - Texas Tech K-12 and Dual Credit Courses

The curriculum blends Texas Tech K-12 courses with dual credit options, designed to challenge and inspire. Courses offered through dual credit are self-paced, allowing students to progress at their own speed and take control of their academic journey.

Dynamic Curriculum - Texas Tech K-12 and Dual Credit Courses

The curriculum blends Texas Tech K-12 courses with dual credit options, designed to challenge and inspire. Courses offered through dual credit are self-paced, allowing students to progress at their own speed and take control of their academic journey.

Supplemental Program Information

Anyone looking to supplement their current school curriculum or home school curriculum can enroll in Texas Tech K-12.  Our Texas Tech K-12 Supplemental Program (opens in new tab) is designed to allow students in elementary, middle and high school that allows students to work at their own pace. We have students who must do their work at home for various reasons, such as travel "outside" of the U.S. for extended amounts of time, have health issues, are actors, entertainers, and athletes who cannot fit the traditional schooling into their schedule. We have school all year and do not keep a traditional academic schedule, so it is possible to move through our program faster than the typical semester-based programs.

This is a self-paced program where all the instructional content is provided. The courses tend to be reading and writing intensive. Online courses require self-discipline and excellent time-management skills. The courses are not virtual classrooms and do not require any interaction with any other students or instructors. Each course has lessons, which are like chapters, and a final exam. The final exam will be proctored online by an online proctoring service.

Flexible Curriculum Options

Asynchronous Enrollment:

Students can enroll in courses and Credit by Exams (CBEs) year-round, without enrollment deadlines, making it easy to:

Step 1: Stay on track to graduate on time or early.

Step 2: Recover credits from failed courses.

Step 3: Earn credits during the summer.

Step 4: Access courses not offered at your school.

Step 5: Test out of subjects through Credit By Exams.

Turnkey Full-Time Program for At-Risk Students:

Recommend our online high school diploma program to students struggling in traditional settings. Students transfer to Texas Tech K-12 to complete courses at their own pace, all while being counted as transfers—not dropouts—on district records.

Commencement

Please read carefully: To apply to this program:

Step 1: it must be consistent with your academic needs,

Step 2: you must be a Texas resident under the age of 25 and provide Proof of Residency (opens in new tab),

Step 3: you must provide a copy of your birth certificate,

Step 4: you must be scheduled into at least four semester courses and maintain satisfactory course progress.

Step 5: State of Texas Assessments of Academic Readiness testing is not a requirement to apply for the tuition free program, but any end of course exam or previous state testing will be taken into consideration in the application process.

Full-time Tuition-based Diploma Program (Outside TX or TX Residents seeking more flexibility) (opens in new tab)

Texas Tech K-12 offers a tuition-based option for students who desire the flexibility of a distance education but reside outside of Texas or do not want the additional restrictions of the tuition-free program. We offer all courses necessary to meet the requirements to complete a Texas high school graduation plan. If you are currently a Texas Tech K-12 student or if you want to withdraw from your local school district to attend Texas Tech K-12 full-time but you do not want the additional restrictions of the tuition-free program, you will select this option. There will be a $200.00 non-refundable Admission fee charged to apply to the Full-time Tuition-based Diploma Program.

Please note that upon enrollment, payment is due. Texas Tech K-12 does not offer payment plans. Once a student submits an assignment for grading, they are no longer eligible for a refund in the tuition-paid or supplemental programs.

**Course Extensions at Texas Tech K-12**

- **No Extensions Allowed**: Texas Tech K-12 does not allow extensions for courses. Students must complete each course within the designated time frame (typically six months/180 days from enrollment).

If you have concerns about completing a course on time, it is recommended to plan your schedule accordingly or contact Texas Tech K-12 for guidance at 1-800-692-6877 or ttuk12@ttu.edu.
